Class ArticleTest

java.lang.Object
org.example.ArticleTest
public class ArticleTest extends Object
Unit tests for the Article class. This class contains a set of JUnit tests for verifying the behavior of the Article class. It tests various functionalities including retrieving item details, managing operations, and parsing CSV input.

  • Method Details

    • setup

      @BeforeEach public void setup()
      Sets up the test environment before each test execution. Initializes a new Article instance with ID "Item1", priority NORMAL, and a list of operations: "Operation1", "Operation2", and "Operation3".

    • testGetIdItem

      @Test public void testGetIdItem()
      Tests the Article.getIdItem() method. Verifies that the item ID is correctly returned as "Item1".

    • testGetPriority

      @Test public void testGetPriority()
      Tests the Article.getPriority() method. Verifies that the priority of the item is correctly returned as NORMAL.

    • testGetNextOperation

      @Test public void testGetNextOperation()
      Tests the Article.getNextOperation() method. Verifies that the next operation is correctly returned as "Operation1".

    • testMoveToNextOperation

      @Test public void testMoveToNextOperation()
      Tests the Article.moveToNextOperation() method. Verifies that the item can successfully move to the next operation and that the next operation is updated to "Operation2".

    • testMoveToNextOperationWhenFinished

      @Test public void testMoveToNextOperationWhenFinished()
      Tests the Article.moveToNextOperation() method when all operations are completed. Moves the item through all available operations and verifies that the method returns false when there are no more operations left.

    • testResetOperations

      @Test public void testResetOperations()
      Tests the Article.resetOperations() method. Moves the item to the second operation and then resets the operations. Verifies that the next operation is set back to "Operation1".

    • testFromCSV_InvalidPriority

      @Test public void testFromCSV_InvalidPriority()
      Tests the Article.fromCSV(String) method with an invalid priority. Verifies that an IllegalArgumentException is thrown when attempting to create an item from a CSV line with an invalid priority value.

    • testFromCSV_InvalidLineFormat

      @Test public void testFromCSV_InvalidLineFormat()
      Tests the Article.fromCSV(String) method with an invalid line format. Verifies that an IllegalArgumentException is thrown when attempting to create an item from a CSV line with an invalid format (missing fields).

    • testToString

      @Test public void testToString()
      Tests the Article.toString() method. Verifies that the string representation of the Article object matches the expected format, including ID, priority, list of operations, and the current operation index.
